SEOwind makes collaboration easy by allowing you to invite team members to your account. Whether you’re working with a colleague, a freelancer, or managing a full content team, you can securely share access to your SEOwind dashboard and content.

### **Roles & Permissions** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/how-to-invite-team/\#0-toc-title)

You can assign two types of roles when inviting team members:

- **Standard Role** – Access to all content and projects
- **Full Role** – Includes everything in the Standard Role, with additional permission to manage the team and access billing settings.

### **Team Member Limits by Plan** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/how-to-invite-team/\#1-toc-title)

Each plan includes a set number of team members:

- **Basic** – 1 team member

- **Pro** – Up to 2 team members

- **Agency** – Up to 5 team members

### **How to Add Team Members** [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/how-to-invite-team/\#2-toc-title)

1. Click your **profile icon** in the top-right corner of the SEOwind dashboard

2. Go to **Settings**
3. Click on the **Team** tab

4. Invite members by entering their email and assigning a role


![seowind invite team members](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/TS1-1024x552.png)

Once invited, your team members will receive an email to join and get access based on their assigned role.
